question: Before the foundation of the Vijayanagar empire, Harihar and Bukka were the nobles of which of the following dynasties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kakatiya of Warangal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Harihara and Bukka** were the **founders **of the Sangama dynasty of Vijayanagar kingdom. They were originally feudatories of the **Kakatiyas of Warangal**.
 
• **Harihara and Bukka Raya** were feudatories of the **Kakatiya rulers** who established their own kingdom at Vijayanagar after adopting **Hinduism**.
 
• **Vijayanagara Empire**:
 
 
• Founded in 1336 in the wake of the rebellions against Tughluq rule in the Deccan, the Vijayanagar empire lasted for more than two centuries&nb
